$comment: Stylesheet rules from docs/design-system/09-migration.md. scripts/lint-css.mjs applies them to every line of src/styles/ui/ and of new stylesheets, and only to added or changed lines of the older ones (their existing lines are the baseline). tokens.css and themes.css are where raw values belong.

color-no-hex.message: Use a colour token (var(--…)) instead of a hex colour (docs/design-system/02-color.md)

color-named.message: Use a colour token (var(--…)) instead of a named colour

function-disallowed-list.message: Use a colour token (var(--…)) instead of a raw colour function

unit-disallowed-list.message: Use a size token (var(--space-…), var(--control-…), var(--radius-…), var(--text-…)) instead of raw px (docs/design-system/03-spacing-density.md)

declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: Not allowed by the design system: no outline:none (draw the focus ring), weights and line heights from tokens, easing from --ease-* (docs/design-system/09-migration.md)
